hospital-platform.title: Healthcare Operations Concept
hospital-platform.tagline: Connected digital workflows for modern healthcare operations.
hospital-platform.statement: A shared operations platform for multi-department hospitals — one patient record, role-based dashboards, and coordinated scheduling.
hospital-platform.description: The problem explored: a multi-department hospital tracking patient records, scheduling, and staff access across disconnected spreadsheets and paper logs.
highlights: One patient record shared across departments instead of re-entered at each desk
Dashboards scoped by role, so a nurse and a billing clerk see only what applies to them
Appointment scheduling that respects each department's own hours and staff availability
hospital-platform.demonstrates: How we'd structure role-based access and a shared data model across departments that don't normally share systems.

school-erp.title: Education Management Concept
school-erp.tagline: Connected school operations across academics, attendance, fees and communication.
school-erp.statement: A connected school operations platform bringing attendance, fees and parent communication into one shared system.
school-erp.description: The problem explored: attendance, fees, and parent communication handled through separate tools that don't talk to each other.
highlights: A single attendance record that drives fee status and parent notifications automatically
Parent-teacher portal scoped to one child's data, not the whole school's
Role-based access so a teacher, an accountant, and a parent each see a different view
school-erp.demonstrates: How we'd design one data model that serves three different user types without exposing data they shouldn't see.

restaurant-website.title: Restaurant Web Presence Concept
restaurant-website.description: The problem explored: a restaurant losing reservations to a slow, desktop-first site when most visits happen on a phone at dinner time.
highlights: Menu structured for one-thumb browsing, not a scanned PDF
Reservation request flow that works in under 30 seconds on mobile
Page structure built around local search intent, not generic copy
restaurant-website.demonstrates: How we'd prioritize mobile load speed and conversion structure for a location-based business.

real-estate-crm.title: Real Estate Operations Concept
real-estate-crm.tagline: A connected property workflow from lead capture through deal management.
real-estate-crm.statement: A shared pipeline for real estate teams — one view of every lead, listing and follow-up, with nothing sitting untouched.
real-estate-crm.description: The problem explored: a sales team losing track of which lead was last contacted, and by whom, across a shared inbox and a spreadsheet.
highlights: One pipeline view so no lead sits untouched without the team noticing
Listing management tied directly to the leads attached to it
Follow-up visibility shared across the team, not locked to one agent's inbox
real-estate-crm.demonstrates: How we'd design a shared pipeline that stays accurate without extra manual logging.

business-website.title: Business Website Concept
business-website.description: The problem explored: a service business whose site describes what they do but gives visitors no clear next step.
highlights: Page structure built around one clear action per screen, not a wall of text
Lead capture placed where intent is highest, not just in the footer
Technical SEO handled at build time, not bolted on afterward
business-website.demonstrates: How we'd structure a site around a single conversion goal instead of trying to say everything at once.

ai-saas-dashboard.title: SaaS Administration Concept
ai-saas-dashboard.tagline: A focused command center for complex SaaS systems and operational data.
ai-saas-dashboard.statement: A multi-tenant admin console with isolated customer data and AI-assisted actions scoped to what each tenant actually owns.
ai-saas-dashboard.description: The problem explored: an admin dashboard for a multi-tenant product where every customer's data has to stay isolated while the AI features stay useful.
highlights: Tenant isolation enforced at the data layer, not just hidden in the UI
AI-assisted actions scoped to the data the requesting tenant actually owns
Usage analytics built as a first-class feature, not an afterthought query
ai-saas-dashboard.demonstrates: How we'd approach multi-tenant data isolation and where AI features should — and shouldn't — have access.
